Name: Optional Combat
Author: brightonmorris1
Description:
I tried to make fighting monsters as optional as possible. There are other mods that do things like this such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5464]pacifist valley[/url], (which I highly recommend!!)

I made this mod because I personally don't prefer running pacifist valley in my modpack since it kind of kills my immersion. I tried to make this one more immersive by adding challenges to unlock slayer quest rewards and having the guild members react to your choices to not kill anything.

Marlon is initially kind of rude because he disagrees with your philosophy while Gil is more neutral about your situation.

[b]Notable changes to the game:[/b]

Adds a PFM machine called "buggy bin" which generates bug [s]meat[/s] [b]eggs [/b]instead of bait. (does not replace bait machine)

Adds two weapons sold by Robin and Krobus which do no damage but have lots of knockback to keep annoying bats at bay. (Assets used with permission from the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6639]Non-lethal Weapons Mod[/url] made by the talented [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/8049772]Draylon[/url].)

Krobus, Dwarf, and Marlon sell the hats that are usually only unlocked via slayer rewards.

Gil and Marlon mail you a bunch of free recipes and stuff for every ~10 floors you go into the mines.

Slime egg-press can use petrified slime to make eggs now, allowing you to start your slime farms a lot easier. (doesn't replace the old recipe)

Krobus stocks all monster drops.

[b]Note: [/b]Resprites/renames are toggled [b]off[/b] by default in the config.
